summary: Fact caching avoids repeated fact gathering on large inventories; enable it with Enable fact storage rather than ansible.cfg (custom fact caching conflicts), clear facts with meta: clear_facts, and read them at /api/v2/hosts/<id>/ansible_facts.
questions: Should I configure fact caching in ansible.cfg for AAP?
How do I clear cached facts in controller?

Why use fact caching in automation controller?
